description: Different model profiles should preserve split placement findings when integration tests escape a package project into an app project.

lockedFields.reason: Escaped integration-level matches should be reported as split findings, not automatic moves.
The analyzer must preserve the app project that currently owns the escaping test file.
The analyzer must preserve the package project that owns the matched source target.
Escaped test paths should be resolved into repository-relative paths.
Placement finding IDs must remain stable for downstream reporting and review workflows.

lockedFields.expected: Existing integration-level test escapes the audited project root while covering source owned by this project.
lockedFields.reason: The reason should clearly explain why this is a split recommendation.
